title: Guard the Rust<->TS delegation fan-in text contract (resume anchors <-> isDelegationFanInText)
outcome:
build_delegation_wait_resume_prompt (src/delegations.rs) emits the fan-in prompt whose literal anchors
('Wait id:', 'Delegations:', 'Results:') are re-detected by isDelegationFanInText (ui/src/message-cards.tsx)
to collapse the card. No shared constant or cross-language test links them: renaming an anchor on the Rust
side silently disables UI collapse with no failing test. Add a guard — e.g. a fixture built from a real
resume prompt asserted to satisfy isDelegationFanInText. Cosmetic impact. Found by Claude in /review-with-delegate.
